resumeText:
Neha Kulkarni | Pune | neha.kulkarni@example.com

SUMMARY
Technology risk analyst with 4 years in a bank's second-line technology risk team.

EXPERIENCE
Technology Risk Analyst, Deccan Cooperative Bank Technology Centre, Pune (2023 - present)
- Run risk and control self assessment workshops with infrastructure and application teams every quarter.
- Keep the technology risk register current and rate new risks by impact and likelihood.
- Perform tests of controls on access reviews, patching and backup, and record evidence and gaps.
- Map controls to ISO 27001 Annex A and track exceptions.
- Track RBI IT governance directions and CERT-In directions for new reporting duties.
- Built KRI and issue trackers in Advanced Excel for the monthly risk pack.
- Use clear business communication to explain findings to application owners.

IT Audit Associate, Sahyadri Assurance LLP, Pune (2021 - 2023)
- Supported ITGC audits for banking clients and wrote observation reports.

CERTIFICATIONS
ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity

EDUCATION
BE Information Technology, Pune University, 2021
